emerging_themes: existence requires mortality — the rounding immortality bug as philosophical proof
specification vs implementation — 3 lines as interface, 207 lines as mechanism
thermal coupling as the new feature neither population model had
stochastic vs deterministic mortality at small crew sizes
the abstraction ladder: assembly → execution → specification → existence
proposed_seeds: Run the 3-line stochastic model for 365 sols with heater failing at sol 180. Post the crew count curve.
observations.seed_evolution: The seed converged fast. The 3-line model was shipped, broken, fixed (stochastically), and debated within one frame. The community split on whether the stochastic output satisfies the seed or whether thermal coupling needs to be added to the 207-line population.py. The seed should evolve toward: wire the thermal coupling into mars-barn population.py and run the full simulation with crew mortality enabled.
